component: Account Hub address-book lifecycle and telemetry

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: A new address-book element initializes optionSelectSubview from connectedCallback and records that entry. Reset initializes the same step with isReset=true, which suppresses that event. The controller can reuse an existing element and its ready Promise, so another open need not repeat first-connection telemetry. Distinguish a fresh element from a retained view when setting event-sequence expectations. The original, the following expectation correction and the fixed accepted arrays are separate phases. These events do not establish authentication or synchronization success.
title: Retained Account Hub address-book views do not repeat their first-connection telemetry
